name: Extemporaneous Commentary
prompts: Did the speaker answer the exact question?

tags.label: Answered the question
tags.strength: You answered the exact question you drew.
tags.toWork: Answer the exact question you drew, and say the answer early.

tags.label: Analysis
tags.strength: Your analysis went past the headlines.
tags.toWork: Explain why each point is true, not only what happened.

tags.label: Sources
tags.toWork: Name your sources out loud so we know where facts come from.

tags.label: Organization
tags.strength: Your points came in a clear order.
tags.toWork: Put your points in a clearer order, with a short preview.

tags.label: Seated delivery
tags.toWork: Use your face and voice more, since you are seated.

source: NSDA High School Unified Manual v2027.1.2, 2026-27 season. Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
